comparison.objective: Commission and lock an industrial damper versus set and start a mechanical metronome at 120 BPM.
comparison.physical_skill: Loosen a recessed setscrew, tune a collar, relock with bounded torque, and cycle-test versus slide a pendulum weight into a notch and initiate oscillation.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe carriage stops plus post-lock setting retention versus autonomous ticking at 120 BPM for five seconds.
comparison.reason: Both adjust a mechanism and observe motion, but the candidate uniquely tests retained damping under impacts, tool-mediated locking, and safety limits. The record has no separate spec and omits some setup thresholds, but its central rubric is clear.
